buildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
_rewrites_note: (.*) and not :path* — deliberately. `/pos/:path*` does not match a path that
ENDS IN A SLASH: the trailing slash leaves an empty final segment and the
rule falls through to the catch-all, which serves the SPA. Every screen the
shop has is a Flask blueprint mounted with a trailing slash — /pos/,
/pos/inventory/, /pos/customers/ — so all of them were being answered with
the warehouse app instead. Inside the POS frame that renders the whole
warehouse again, header and all, which renders another frame, which is why
the page came out as three stacked copies of itself.
